resources.string: Notifications
Without notifications the ringing screen cannot appear over the lock screen.
Exact alarms
Needed so the alarm rings right on time.
Full-screen notifications
Lets the ringing screen open on a locked phone.
Display over other apps
The ringing screen opens even while you use another app.
No battery restrictions
The system will not put the app to sleep in the background.
Background activity
In \"Restricted\" mode the alarm may not ring. Choose \"Unrestricted\" or \"Optimized\".
Autostart and background work
Some phones (Xiaomi, Huawei, Oppo, Vivo, Samsung) need background work allowed separately.
Do Not Disturb
Alarms must be allowed through Do Not Disturb.
Alarm volume
The alarm volume is off, so you will not hear the ring.
Scheduling
Not every alarm is set in the system. Retry scheduling.
